mech_note: Drain Essence: channel a vitality-aether tether beam that splits across multiple nearby targets, dealing vitality damage while restoring the caster's life per hit. Spellbinder (Arcanist + Necromancer) uses Bonemonger set or Diviner's Raiment to convert aether into vitality and amplify the drain. The split-beam mechanic means the channel sustains the caster's HP against any pack density — more targets hit means more healing, making this the genre's safest channel identity for melee-range packs. The beam requires proximity (medium range) but the constant healing outpaces incoming damage at that range with proper resistances. The life-drain-as-offense-and-defense fusion makes this a uniquely self-contained archetype: damage IS the sustain tool. Tanky and reliable across all Grim Dawn difficulties.

mech_note: Last Epoch Skeleton Necromancer: skeletal warriors, mages, and Death Knight (via the Exsanguinous passive or Skeleton Warrior Mage upgrades) deployed as a sustained army. Rogue of the Dead passive tree node upgrades warriors into aggressive flankers; Dread Shade aura buffs the whole army. mech_note: Tag-bank-payout grammar: the 'bank' is the Doom window; the 'payout' is detonation. Wind-up commit because the damage is temporally decoupled from the hit — you commit to the hit, damage resolves later. Doom is the canonical 'hit-now-damage-later' archetype. Pairs with Merciful End to remove the delay.
